{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Replace -1 in customer_age with NaN (missing)
df['customer_age'] = df['customer_age'].replace(-1, pd.NA)

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Drop the six QA orders with revenue 999999.99
qa_mask = df['revenue'] == 999999.99
df = df[~qa_mask]

# Drop refunded orders (status == 'refunded')
completed_mask = df['status'] == 'completed'
df = df[completed_mask]

# Compute conversion rate within each segment
stratified_conv = df.groupby(['customer_segment', 'channel'])['converted'].mean().reset_index()

# Extract and print the actual conversion rates for each segment and channel
print("Actual conversion rates by segment and channel:")
print(stratified_conv)

# Compute the differences
loyal_diff = stratified_conv.loc[(stratified_conv['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (stratified_conv['channel'] == 'email'), 'converted'].iloc[0] - \
             stratified_conv.loc[(stratified_conv['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (stratified_conv['channel'] == 'paid_search'), 'converted'].iloc[0]
new_diff = stratified_conv.loc[(stratified_conv['customer_segment'] == 'new') & (stratified_conv['channel'] == 'email'), 'converted'].iloc[0] - \
           stratified_conv.loc[(stratified_conv['customer_segment'] == 'new') & (stratified_conv['channel'] == 'paid_search'), 'converted'].iloc[0]
returning_diff = stratified_conv.loc[(stratified_conv['customer_segment'] == 'returning') & (stratified_conv['channel'] == 'email'), 'converted'].iloc[0] - \
                 stratified_conv.loc[(stratified_conv['customer_segment'] == 'returning') & (stratified_conv['channel'] == 'paid_search'), 'converted'].iloc[0]

print("\nDifferences (email - paid_search):")
print(f"Loyal: {loyal_diff:.4f}")
print(f"New: {new_diff:.4f}")
print(f"Returning: {returning_diff:.4f}")"}
